concepts.definition: The Product-owned accepted declaration of the shared frame set for finite actors collectively engaging one governed Product scope or outcome. It binds the exact Reference Frame Method and optional profile, admitting authorities and scopes, frame declarations and evaluations, actor rules and capabilities, semantic/evaluation/operation/decision grants, result/conjunction/translation/coverage relations, activation triggers and invalidation law.

grounding.quote:
A **Project Reference-Frame Basis** is the Product-owned accepted declaration
of the shared frame set through which finite actors collectively engage one
governed Product scope or outcome. It binds:

concepts.label: Project Reference-Frame Basis

concepts.definition: Execution-scoped binding of one agent to an applicable frame declaration or active configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis, evidence boundary and capability envelope; distinct from the durable collective basis.

grounding.quote:
An **Agent Frame Activation**
is the execution-scoped binding of one agent to an applicable
frame declaration or active configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis,
evidence boundary, and capability envelope.

concepts.label: Agent Frame Activation

concepts.definition: The SPEC_METHOD-owned build-tenancy context, urn:stdo:bounded-context:build-tenancy, relates one constitutional requirements WHAT to one or more independent project-owned HOW realizations. A tenant is one realization; multiple independent realizations constitute multi-build-tenancy. WHAT specifies admissible states, outcomes, constraints, evidence and permitted changes. Tenant design binds operations, composition, actors or mechanisms, effects, assumptions and observations through software, hardware, people, organisations or mixtures.

grounding.quote:
A
**build tenant** is one such realization. **Build tenancy** is the one-or-more
relation; one tenant is its singleton case and multi-build-tenancy begins when
the same `WHAT` has more than one independent realization.

concepts.label: Build tenancy, WHAT and HOW

concepts.definition: Canonical locators distinguish constitutional WHAT, tenant realizations and work carriers: what.intent and what.product each have one canonical entrypoint; what.specification may name multiple surfaces. how.build_tenants is the Tenant Registry; how.common binds an explicitly shared realization law. ticketing.goals, tickets, comments and optional sprints locate work-wave, ticket, commentary and execution-batch surfaces.

grounding.quote:
The **Tenant Registry** is the canonical `how.build_tenants` collection for the
product's independent `HOW` realizations. Each entry has stable identity and
locates its root, design, and implementation surfaces. The **Common Build-Tenant Surface**
is the realization law bound by `how.common` and
explicitly adopted across more than one tenant.

concepts.label: Definition and work carriers

concepts.definition: Recursive discovery of stdo_*.json throughout a selected workspace, including root and arbitrarily deep project roots; explicit directed composition relates otherwise independent definitions through target locator, stable target identity, relation authority and non-empty governing contract references.

grounding.quote:
Directory nesting creates no implicit inheritance, ownership, composition, or
constitutional override. Parent and child definitions remain independent until
`composition` explicitly relates them.

concepts.label: Recursive discovery and explicit composition

concepts.definition: Conformance under an exact selected basis covering uniquely resolved uses and material collisions, including distinct Frame, Owner, Product and Tenant contexts and unresolved User meanings absent downstream definition or explicit relation.

grounding.quote:
Conformance covers both uniquely resolved use and material collision. At
minimum, it establishes these cases under an exact selected basis:

concepts.label: Semantic-resolution conformance

concepts.definition: STDO-SURFACE-001 chooses one complete released method cut admitted by release authority and one owning standard per law. Authorship is modular; operative authority is singular. A released cut identifies exact members, digests, review basis, human acceptance and immutable identity.

grounding.quote:
The shared methodology is modular in authorship and singular in authority.
Each law has one owning standard; other standards consume it by reference. The
standards become operative only as one complete released STDO version.

concepts.label: One constitutional surface and version boundary

concepts.definition: The homeostatic chain runs Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta → Scenarios → Gap Analysis → intake-selected re-entry or observation. Goals select current concerns; Intent gives purpose; mutable Product Definition gives terms and decomposable end-state shape; Requirements state invariant obligations; Design selects structures and delivery; ADRs are design records; Realisation includes software and human procedures; Observations record bounded facts; Projection presents relevant observations; Delta exposes drift; Scenarios test operational meaning; Gap Analysis locates insufficiency.

grounding.quote:
Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                  Scenarios
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                Gap Analysis

concepts.label: Constitutional chain

concepts.definition: A bounded execution-control surface under existing constitutional authority, capable of batching work and local compliance escrow; neither a new constitutional layer nor automatic acceptance.

grounding.quote:
A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface.

It is not a new layer in the constitutional chain.

concepts.label: Sprint execution boundary

concepts.definition: SPEC_METHOD owns the substrate-neutral ambiguity-governance context. Major ambiguity materially changes architecture, stack, Product boundary, execution/deployment admissibility, public contracts or downstream realization law; micro ambiguity stays within governed design. Lawful Probabilistic Processing is policy-permitted bounded non-human handling of declared ambiguity; Human Adjudication is authority-admitted explicit human judgment where policy or risk requires it. Handling labels and resolution, lawful-decision, admissibility and fulfillment predicates remain distinct.

grounding.quote:
**Lawful Probabilistic Processing**
(`urn:stdo:concept:ambiguity-governance:lawful-probabilistic-processing`) is
bounded non-human processing permitted by declared policy to carry or resolve
declared ambiguity. **Human Adjudication**
(`urn:stdo:concept:ambiguity-governance:human-adjudication`) is explicit human
judgment admitted by authority to resolve declared ambiguity where policy or
risk appetite requires it.

concepts.label: Ambiguity governance

concepts.definition: Every material Product, application, module, graph function, runtime/plugin/public/data surface or capability has an operational lifecycle: intent → requirement → build → assurance → release → deployment → live usage → observed telemetry → retirement.

grounding.quote:
Any material product, application, module, graph function, runtime surface,
plugin surface, public interface, data surface, or capability has an operational
lifecycle.

concepts.label: Operational lifecycle

concepts.definition: Substantive change has an explicit declared intent, intake classification and lawful entry into the constitutional chain.

grounding.quote:
Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

concepts.label: Substantive change

concepts.definition: The common intake route for bugs, feature requests, issues, regressions, operator findings, release blockers and scenario failures. It diagnoses current failing or changing relations and selects lawful classes: goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe and realization_refactor.

grounding.quote:
There is one front door for substantive change.

The intake label does not determine the process class.

concepts.label: Universal intake triage

conditions: Assurance or intake requires causal diagnosis of a counterexample on a declared path.
concepts.definition: Localization finds the earliest evidence-supported causal frontier: one violated locus, a jointly necessary set of incomparable minimal violated loci, unresolved alternative frontiers, or indeterminate when no bounded frontier is supported. Earliest is causal minimality, not log or clock order.
exceptions: It does not add a separate pass to every change.

grounding.quote:
A testing counterexample is returned to its earliest supported causal frontier
on the declared path. The frontier contains the causally minimal violated owner
relations or seam coordinates established by the evidence; earliest means
minimal under the declared causal relation, not first in log or clock order.

concepts.label: Counterexample localization

concepts.definition: Reusable intake classification distinguishes C, reproducible facts and declared rule application; J, residual semantic or materiality judgment; and O, rulings reserved to actual owners. These are annotations, not new calculus kinds, runtime interfaces, mandatory documents or authority grants. Computation exposes authority traversal, public delta, accepted-design coverage and rule-determined treatment.

grounding.quote:
`C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
mandatory document.

concepts.label: Computed classification and treatment

concepts.definition: Closure of a declared change span evaluates all applicable obligations and required judgments or rulings together, with no active non-closure condition. This conjunction differs from local artifact fitness.

grounding.quote:
Closure of a declared change span applies
[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to reliance
on its closure evidence, then evaluates the conjunction of all applicable
obligations and required judgments or rulings, with no active non-closure
condition.

concepts.label: Consistency gate

concepts.definition: A Product-outcome-bearing work wave selects one unresolved, directly verifiable Product-defined outcome instance and acceptance interval. Material advance, prerequisite readiness, preservation and regression are progress annotations on distinct predicates. Named bounded prerequisites and decision-discriminating experiments are provisional bases, distinct from Product progress or closure.

grounding.quote:
Every Product-outcome-bearing work wave identifies one explicitly selected,
unresolved, directly verifiable Product-defined outcome and declares the
acceptance interval for that instance. Product-progress claims and promotion
onto the supported Product path are judged against that same outcome.

concepts.label: Product outcome and bounded work basis

concepts.definition: Proportionality compares material semantic ambiguity removed with effective reasoning complexity introduced. Complexity includes concepts, authority surfaces, document joins, exceptions, branches, states, transitions, duplicated representations and decision detail, rather than raw size. Delivery priority applies this relation to the current outcome, likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependency and feedback delay.

grounding.quote:
Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and
effective reasoning complexity introduced. A method obligation is proportional
when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space justifies the
additional concepts, relations, projections, and evidence that an agent must
hold together to reach a correct decision.

concepts.label: Proportional method and delivery

conditions: A selected outcome, delegated affected cone, concrete execution binding and separately bound assessment and decision authority exist.
concepts.definition: UP-020 describes outcome-driven construction through accepted basis, bounded affected relations, selected computational relations, delegated authority, construction/self-review, required independent live assessment, accept/local repair/re-enter/reject, exact accepted checkpoint and next already-authorized action.

grounding.quote:
This family assumes a selected outcome, a delegated affected cone, a concrete
execution binding and separately bound assessment and decision authority.

concepts.label: Agentic construction execution

concepts.definition: The sufficient intake binding for a proposed bounded action identifies the outcome/prerequisite/experiment, affected relations and invariants, admitted transformations, computational or common-library dispositions, construction and assessment authority, and upstream re-entry conditions.
concepts.label: Sufficient execution intake

concepts.definition: The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering selected behavior while preserving every affected governing relation.

grounding.quote:
the
smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering the selected
behavior while preserving every affected governing relation. Its material seams
follow that condition, not function, file, module, ticket or document boundaries.

concepts.label: Bounded causal construction

concepts.definition: Construction, independent assessment and bounded proxy decision are distinct roles. The constructor owns implementation and self-review; the assessor examines exact live realization and evidence; an authorized proxy has only its declared decision envelope.

grounding.quote:
The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Apply
[Independent assessment](FOUNDATIONS.md#independent-assessment) wherever
independent assessment supports promotion. The assessor evaluates the exact
live realisation
under the selected computational binding, its authority paths, proof, and
installed subject rather than treating the constructor's summary as sufficient
evidence. The selected configuration binds actors to that claim under the shared
independence conditions; this construction binding prescribes no actor count.

concepts.label: Construction, assessment and delegation

concepts.definition: Assessment of whether an exact candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation returns evidence and a proposed semantic disposition. Applied disposition is a separate decision under bound authority; candidate availability is another construction predicate.

grounding.quote:
Assessment evaluates the exact predicate `the candidate closes its declared
cone and preserves every affected governing relation` through the shared
[result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra). It returns evidence and a
proposed semantic disposition. Apply [Dispose](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#dispose)
to the separate decision on that proposal, using this section's construction
conditions and the existing authority's bound mandate.

concepts.label: Proportional disposition

concepts.definition: A consumer-represented read model identifying exact candidate, affected relations, changed realization and authority paths, retained/open seams, focused and required integration proof, explicit non-changes, proposed disposition and separately applied decision.

grounding.quote:
Transition
evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
admission authority.

concepts.label: Transition evidence and proof cadence

concepts.definition: Acceptance binds an exact checkpoint. A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an exact existing operation grant without acceptance, promotion or publication. Progress and churn are semantic categories: accepted material outcome movement versus rejected or superseded construction history/cost.

grounding.quote:
A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an
existing exact operation grant. Identify its parent or predecessor, included
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location. It is
neither acceptance, promotion nor publication.

concepts.label: Checkpoint, continuation, progress and churn

conditions: A consequential transition has actual admission owners.
concepts.definition: UP-021 admission assesses the exact complete material transition at one current authoritative basis, covering every participant and equality join capable of affecting or being affected by identity, validity, authority, currentness or transition. Assessed admission, authorized decision, actual semantic commit and atomicity are separate claims.

grounding.quote:
Its support universe is
every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority,
currentness or transition can affect or be affected by admission. The owner
independently derives and validates that relation from authoritative inputs;
the shared Support condition governs crossing seams and independence claims.

concepts.label: Complete enclosing-relation admission

concepts.definition: Standing qualification is instantiated for every admission owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design, with cases applicable to its supported input, state and operating/threat model.

grounding.quote:
Qualification is instantiated for every admission owner and supported boundary
declared by accepted design. Case applicability follows the supported input,
state and operating/threat model. An excluded threat alone cannot create an
acceptance predicate or require defensive work; any proposed scope expansion
returns to its owning authority. Supported malformed inputs, stale state and
effect boundaries retain their required checks:

concepts.label: Standing structural qualification

concepts.definition: A core interface is any shared contract or carrier materially governing runtime closure, reporting/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification outcomes, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution or provider/resolver behavior. A change capable of altering how multiple surfaces decide current truth is a core-interface change.

grounding.quote:
If changing the interface can alter how multiple surfaces decide "what is true
now," it is a core interface change.

concepts.label: Core interface

conditions: A change alters a load-bearing shared interface on which multiple surfaces depend.
concepts.definition: Constitutional migration replaces shared contract authority across producers, consumers and views, with hard-break sequencing, re-adoption, path-relative promotion and final retirement; it is not an ordinary local patch or automatic deletion rule.

grounding.quote:
Where a change alters a load-bearing contract, carrier, resolver, provider,
projection law, closure law, or other shared interface that multiple surfaces
depend on, the work must be handled as a constitutional migration rather than
as incremental patching.

concepts.label: Core interface migration

concepts.definition: Two lawful strategies: Inside-Out Hard-Break replaces authoritative source truth in place on the same implementation line, breaking and repairing outward; Fundamental Re-Adoption intentionally re-derives a major rewrite on a materially different runtime/carrier/type/execution/realization basis and moves the predecessor sideways as reference, not live authority. Bounded evolution is a strategy-selection presumption, not a third strategy.

grounding.quote:
- **Inside-Out Hard-Break Migration**: use this when the project remains on the
  same implementation line and the authoritative source truth is being replaced
  in place. The work proceeds from source carrier outward through a sequence of
  deliberate breaks and repairs.
- **Fundamental Re-Adoption Migration**: use this when the rewrite is major and
  the project is intentionally re-deriving itself on a materially different
  implementation basis, such as a new runtime model, carrier model, type
  system, execution substrate, or realization tree. The prior implementation is
  moved sideways and treated as reference material, not live authority.

concepts.label: Constitutional migration strategies

concepts.definition: An immutable operative release cut bounds the feature set accepted at that point and belongs to release metadata and evaluation, distinct from discovery and current constitutional or shared-realization surfaces.

grounding.quote:
The immutable
cut bounds the feature set accepted at that point and belongs to release
metadata and evaluation. Active constitutional and shared realization surfaces
describe current truth by role, boundary and status rather than release-line
branding. Release criteria, publication and advancement remain Release Method's
decisions.

concepts.label: Release version boundary

concepts.definition: Evidence establishes only its bound property. Claim owners supply property and scope; authorized evaluators provide evidence rather than replacement targets. The evidence family distinguishes proof-target adequacy, semantic/evidence/projection separation and composite assurance qualification.

grounding.quote:
The claim owner supplies the property and required scope; the
authorized evaluator supplies evidence, not a substitute target.

concepts.label: Evidence rules

conditions: The proof is load-bearing.
concepts.definition: An exact proof target binds subject, intended property, governing basis, witness-to-claim relation, nearest weaker excluded property and falsification condition; evidence discovery lacking these is not closure-grade proof.

grounding.quote:
Before selecting that witness, bind its relation to the claim, the nearest
weaker excluded property and the falsification condition. Missing these
relations leaves evidence discovery, not closure-grade proof.

concepts.label: Proof target identity and adequacy

concepts.definition: Semantic basis consists of constitutional and accepted-design relations defining meaning; evidence basis comprises exact artifacts, events, logs, tests and observations evaluating it; state projection is a current view derived from admitted semantic and evidence bases.

grounding.quote:
- **semantic basis**: constitutional and accepted-design relations defining
  what a claim means;
- **evidence basis**: exact artifacts, events, logs, tests, and observations
  used to evaluate it; and
- **state projection**: a current view derived from admitted semantic and
  evidence bases.

concepts.label: Semantic, evidence and projection bases

concepts.definition: Assurance evaluates the authoritative composite subject for a claimed promotion or closure predicate. Generic method qualification uses a fresh competent constructor within a declared capability/context/configuration envelope, ordinary declared method and authority surfaces, and an independently authorized evaluator with a declared basis and comparison predicate.

grounding.quote:
Its support boundary is the authoritative composite subject;
single-carrier evidence leaves unexamined cross-carrier obligations open.

concepts.label: Assurance-boundary congruence and method qualification

concepts.definition: Requirements preserve invariant truth; Design preserves structural choice; Scenarios preserve operational meaning. Scenarios are concrete end-to-end Product-owner use cases testing the chain from intent to realized behavior.

grounding.quote:
| **Requirements** | Invariant truth | "What must be true?" |
| **Design** | Structural choice | "How is that truth realized?" |
| **Scenarios** | Operational meaning | "Can the realized system actually do the claimed thing?" |

concepts.label: Verification layers

concepts.definition: SPEC_METHOD owns Product-level product-assurance taxonomy while DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD retains module-derived unit-proof authority. Two primary authority classes are design/module conformance, derived from realization law, and UAT/acceptance, derived from constitutional Product authority. Execution breadth is separate. Sandbox UAT is composed-product acceptance; harnessed/fake/recorded/deterministic execution is non-live, while live requires real external worker or transport execution.

grounding.quote:
Authority source is not the same thing as execution breadth. A test may be
small or broad, fast or slow, deterministic or live, but it still derives from
one of two primary authorities:

1. **Design/module conformance tests**
2. **UAT / acceptance tests**

concepts.label: Testing strategy taxonomy

concepts.definition: Proof-fixture portability makes required closure lanes reproducible from their declared source boundary while distinguishing fixture availability from the Product property under evaluation.

grounding.quote: Required closure lanes must be reproducible from the declared source boundary.

concepts.label: Fixture and proof portability

concepts.definition: Written traceable testcase authority for live requirements may take the form of scenario bundles, ordered sequences, negative/control cases or other explicit evidence cases appropriate to the truth being proved.

grounding.quote:
That authority may include scenario bundles, ordered testcase sequences, negative
or control cases, and other explicit evidence cases as appropriate to the kind of
truth being proved, but it must exist in written form and be traceable.

concepts.label: Test authority

concepts.definition: A scenario bundle or equivalent ordered testcase set makes operational meaning inspectable through a coherent feature/use-case boundary, proving sequence and expected significant-step outcomes. Declared scenarios identify operational boundaries, actors, controls and significant paths and pressure feature intent and design.

grounding.quote:
Where a requirement claims meaningful system behavior, the proving surface should
be a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered set of testcases that exercises that
behavior through a coherent sequence rather than as disconnected fragments.

concepts.label: Scenario bundle

conditions: The system has an installable or runnable development form.
concepts.definition: The decisive proof lane exercises an installed development version as an independent project or externalized target, beyond in-place source-tree checks.

grounding.quote:
Where a system has an installable or runnable development form, the decisive
proving lane runs against an installed development version as if it were an
independent project or externalized target, not only against the source tree in
place.

concepts.label: Installed development proof

concepts.definition: Significant paths are the meaningful paths of claimed behavior, usually including applicable success, rejection/fail-closed, boundary/control, integration/dispatch/transport and recovery/retry/replay paths. Exhaustive proof here means intentional proof of declared meaningful paths, not every branch in every file.

grounding.quote:
Exhaustive proof does not mean every possible branch in every file. It means the
project names the meaningful paths and proves them intentionally.

concepts.label: Significant path coverage

concepts.definition: Four constitutional requirement categories classify asserted truth: Capability supplies behavior/function/surface; Constraint or Guarantee bounds behavior through invariants/laws/safety/portability/semantics; Governance controls lifecycle/authority/visibility/release/operator action; Verification requires tests/evidence/traceability/qualification/forensics. Category is neither priority nor user-facing status.

grounding.quote:
| **Capability** | A behavior, function, or surface the system must provide | "What can the system do?" |
| **Constraint / Guarantee** | An invariant, law, safety property, portability rule, or semantic guarantee that bounds how the system may behave | "What must always remain true?" |
| **Governance** | A policy or control rule over lifecycle, authority, visibility, release, or operator action | "What governs use and change?" |
| **Verification** | A requirement on tests, evidence, traceability, qualification, or forensic surfaces | "How do we know the claim is true?" |

concepts.label: Requirement categories

concepts.definition: Specification-driven reconstruction is sufficient ordered derivability by a competent team: Goals to conformant Intent, Intent to Product, Product to Requirements, Requirements to Design, and Requirements plus Design to Realization in its selected environment. Sufficiency does not require unique, deterministic or identical realizations.

grounding.quote:
This does not mean the derivation is unique. Different designs may satisfy the
same requirements, and different software, human or mixed realizations may
satisfy the same design. The test is sufficiency, not determinism.

concepts.label: Reconstruction litmus

concepts.definition: Requirements state which control or delivery surfaces must exist; Design chooses their concrete mechanisms, including unconstrained stack, carrier, runtime, entry documents, embedded blocks, compiled artifacts or other lawful topology.

grounding.quote:
Requirements state what control or delivery surfaces must exist.

Design decides the concrete mechanism that realizes them.

If a technology stack, carrier, or runtime is not already constrained by an
upstream constitutional surface, choosing it is part of design rather than a
separate upstream authority.

concepts.label: Design realization choice

grounding.quote:
Profile availability, Product adoption, and execution-scoped activation are
three distinct relations. Inclusion in a selected method cut makes a profile
available. Only Product authority may adopt it. Only an exact authorized work
instruction may activate one bound frame for an actor and subject.

constraints.statement: reference_frame_bases is non-empty; each locator names one accepted declaration URI, every admitting lawful authority and exact governed scope. The declaration owns the binding; the locator neither contains nor adopts it nor creates authority. Reference Frame Method supplies principles and the baseline an optional profile; neither selects or owns Product adoption. Existing Product authority owns every grant. Product definition records the durable basis; authorized work carries activation, which does not mutate the overlay, register agents, assign permanent frames or persist temporary configurations. Actors and frames remain distinct; names or broad frames grant no semantic, operation, review, acceptance or disposition authority beyond cited owners and exact activation. For cross-Product outcomes, the basis records distinct Source Projects, Product Definitions, candidate checkpoints, Release Cuts, released Products, Installs, Artifacts and dependent Products; Development Product is a role over an exact Install. Each directed composition edge names roles, authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal and invalidation conditions. Shared actors, repositories, files, implementations, outputs or tool access establish neither composition nor identity. A same-named runtime/domain/Product Frame enters the frame set only by explicit declaration with required evaluation and authority relations; otherwise it remains governed by its WHAT/HOW and may be an evaluation subject or coordinate.

grounding.quote:
At design admission, each affected requirement identifies its realising
operation or invariant, the preservation obligation at its interfaces, and the
evidence capable of defeating the claimed realisation. The binding preserves
applicable authority, required human decisions, independence, failure and
recovery conditions; a convenient execution environment cannot weaken them.

constraints.statement: At design admission every affected requirement identifies its operation or invariant, interface preservation and defeating evidence. Preserve authority, required human decisions, independence, failure and recovery despite execution convenience. Material context, time, memory, communication, human effort and spend have units and measurements at the declared binding boundary. Context fit and attention adequacy have distinct external evidence conditions; categorical preservation additionally consumes Orthogonal descriptions. A requirement-operation route alone proves neither preservation nor fitness; tenants cannot silently change common WHAT. Author identity, actor identity and operation kind are distinct; a person's procedure is not thereby adjudication. a_c neither selects an executor nor proves realization by structural validation. Every tenant entry has stable identity and root/design/implementation locators; a companion TENANT_REGISTRY.md cannot become second identity/location authority. Ticket bindings include durable root and minimum backlog, active and completed lanes; Goals own work-wave scope, ticket state remains ticket authority and comments remain non-authoritative.

grounding.quote:
Resolution verifies both locator and expected identity. Moving a definition
requires a locator update but does not change its identity. Replacing content
at the same locator with another definition identity fails closed. When an edge
binds exact immutable Product or release versions, the cited relation and
contracts also carry and verify those identities; the mutable definition
identity cannot substitute for them.

constraints.statement: Composition entries require product_definition locator, target_definition_id matching target product.definition_id, relation authority specifying directed kind/roles/owner/scope/lifecycle/invalidators, and one or more exact consumed contracts. Resolve locator and identity; moves update locator without changing identity; identity replacement at the same locator fails closed. Exact immutable Product/release identities must also be carried and verified where bound. Every discovered definition validates against its selected released schema; all required URIs/fragments resolve within declared workspace/resolver boundaries; definition IDs are globally unique and tenant IDs unique within each overlay. Every governed scope has applicable resolvable frame basis, with overlaps authority-reconciled. Every local disambiguation binds exact term, context, complete material candidate set, selected concept, authority, basis and scope; resolves_to belongs to disambiguates and its carrier is congruent. Every material cross-context seam has explicit import/disambiguation/translation/equivalence rather than nominal matching. Every composition target, relation and non-empty contract set resolves. No two carriers claim authority for the same Product, tenant, ticket state or constitutional relation. Draft 2020-12 schema establishes shape; URI formats are annotations unless asserted. Conformance explicitly checks RFC 3986 syntax with an assertion-capable validator, then separately resolution, fragments, selected-release identity, cross-file uniqueness, constitutional sufficiency, semantic/cross-context completeness and authority congruence.

conditions: Conformance is evaluated under an exact selected basis.

grounding.quote:
A positive local case declares one context and resolves exactly one concept. A
positive cross-context case supplies the complete authorized relation. Negative
cases cover zero candidates, multiple candidates after disambiguation,
selected concept outside the candidate set, context-free glossary fallback,
incomplete relation coordinates, authority or basis mismatch, undeclared loss,
and invalidated relations. Correct downstream behavior produced through a
guessed meaning does not pass semantic conformance.

constraints.statement: Without explicit cross-context relation, evaluation Frame and runtime Frame stay distinct; generic specialist Owner evaluation family gains no semantic/decision owner authority; immutable released Product and mutable Product Definition stay distinct and selection follows occurrence context; build Tenant supplies no default for hosted/customer/account/runtime/data tenancy; User remains unresolved among role, person, principal, account, actor, operator and data subject until downstream authority defines or relates meanings. Minimum conformance includes positive local one-context/one-concept resolution, positive complete authorized cross-context relation, and negative zero/multiple candidates, out-of-set selection, context-free glossary fallback, incomplete coordinates, authority/basis mismatch, undeclared loss and invalidated relations. Guessed meaning fails conformance even if downstream behavior is correct.
constraints.uncertainty: The supplied cases intentionally leave User unresolved absent downstream authority.

exceptions: Concrete form becomes method law only when explicitly accepted by the method as an interoperability boundary.

grounding.quote:
Within their declared scope, derived instructions preserve the owning clauses'
applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, decision owners and
invalidators. A projected prohibition cannot lose its condition or lawful
alternative even when every source digest is correct. A summary, bootstrap or
index cannot require a stricter or weaker relation by compression. Its
references must be resolvable within the declared actor's access; otherwise the
required meaning is supplied directly.

constraints.statement: A view cannot change meaning or authority under the selected constitution. Compressions, templates, comments, candidates, installed copies and mutable source remain derived/evidential/authoring surfaces, never selectable partial constitutions or reinterpretations. Derived instructions retain scope, applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, owners, invalidators, prohibition conditions and lawful alternatives without strengthening or weakening; inaccessible references require directly supplied meaning. STDO owns construction algebra, authority/state/transition/admissibility/order/evidence laws; consumers own concrete types, schemas, files, tools, runtimes, orchestration, tests and conformance implementations. Shared-method amendments cannot expand STDO Product scope to executable tools, engines, runtimes, assurance systems or consumer realizations without separate explicit human authorization. Recorded rulings cannot be widened in subject, implication, authority or change class. Only released versions are publication authority; mutable source may author a future cut but cannot silently govern consumers.

exceptions: Design chooses where and how required surfaces are realized unless the path itself is constitutional.

grounding.quote:
The workspace persists through this loop. At each activation, current material
state and valid authority define the new A; Z names the admitted acceptance
constraints. The actor acquires sufficient context for the next bounded
transition. Discarding that context does not rewind A. A new observation can
invalidate a belief or dependent result; it cannot silently change Z or create
permission. Revising Z follows the owning re-entry relation below.

constraints.statement: Downstream success requires adequate upstream meaning and traceable authority; every link is load-bearing, and missing repricing paths, unowned requirements, ungrounded design or undesigned realization create accidental law. Goals/Product owners select outcomes; Design may select any permitted realization, not a uniquely derived implementation. ADRs are not an extra constitutional layer. Projection is checked against source/current state, is not another truth surface and does not require complete event replay by every consumer. Repricing follows intake-selected class and owner; a constitutional gap changes that layer and affected downstream span without automatically requiring new Goals/Intent. Unresolved cause remains unresolved and may require observation. Current state and valid authority define A; admitted acceptance constraints define Z; context disposal never rewinds A and observations cannot silently change Z or grant permission. GOALS.md holds bounded temporary focus until intentionally repriced; PRODUCT.md states present mutable-project definition, terms and boundaries, not immutable RC or Install. Requirements cover all constitutional truths; Design chooses structure and carriers. WHAT/HOW separation survives physical layout; tenant-local realization stays derivative until governing truth is ratified in specification.

grounding.quote:
Deferred compliance inside a sprint is escrow, not acceptance. It cannot satisfy
method, release, or product closure until it is paid down, explicitly accepted
under the governing method, or repriced into the appropriate upstream surface.

constraints.statement: A lawful sprint names served goal/work-wave, upstream authorities, admitted scope, excluded Product/requirement/design/runtime/data/governance boundaries, expected change classes, any deferrable local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law and paydown/repricing route. Deferred proof optimization is lawful only for local, visible, bounded, repayable cost. Escrow does not satisfy method/release/Product closure until paid, explicitly accepted under governing method or repriced upstream. Close may be recommended, not automatically required, on timebox expiry, scope reached, iteration cost exceeding review, unsafe review uncertainty or gaps making the container unsuitable. Close reconciles accumulated work/evidence against authority, classifies each gap, accepts compliant work, opens local paydown and escalates drift by lawful class; it is not automatic approval. Discovery of any Product-truth change does not authorize landing via sprint manifest: split, escalate, reprice or carry explicit paydown under governing method. Ticket Method owns mechanics; domain refinements may define appropriate escrow uses.

grounding.quote:
Major ambiguity must always be surfaced and governed. It may not remain hidden
inside informal operator judgment, ambient precedent, or silent model choice.

Therefore, at each major boundary the process must:

- detect and record the major ambiguity that remains or is newly introduced
- identify the affected invariant, asset, or decision boundary
- record the decision taken if work proceeds
- record whether the ambiguity was resolved, carried forward, escalated, or
  blocked

Ambiguity detection is mandatory. Blocking is policy.

constraints.statement: Unsupported meaning cannot become established result or permission. At every major boundary detect and record remaining/new major ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, decision if proceeding, and resolved/carried/escalated/blocked handling. Goals narrow priority, Intent scope, Product shape/terms, Requirements obligations, tenant/stack realization class, Design structure and implementation local detail; ambiguity reduction need not be uniform or total before work. Detection is mandatory; declared Product risk policy governs remaining handling, with ambiguity and decisions recorded under either lower or higher risk appetite. Graph-native F_D/F_P/F_H are not imported into substrate-neutral ambiguity governance without explicit relation. Resolution predicate is satisfied for established resolution, falsified for established remaining ambiguity, indeterminate for insufficient evidence. Lawful-handling predicate separately is satisfied for supported policy/authority compliance, falsified for demonstrated violation and indeterminate for unsupported handling. Both retain invalid_basis/out_of_frame diagnoses; carried/escalated need not mean resolved and neither result decides delivery or extends authority.

conditions: A non-optional hard-stop condition applies.

grounding.quote:
A witnessed invariant violation
or unmet required authorization falsifies the corresponding admissibility
predicate; missing evidence about that condition leaves it indeterminate.
Admissibility and fulfillment of the interrupted task remain separate
predicates: refusal alone does not establish that the intended outcome failed.
An unusable governing
basis or an evaluation outside capability retains its own diagnosis. The stop
label proves neither non-performance nor absence of effects; an undeclared or
uncertain effect needs actual observation before dependent action.

constraints.statement: Risk appetite cannot waive hard stops. Typical, non-exhaustive classes are violated invariants/guarantees, absent required authority, missing declared operational capability, undeclared irreversible effects and explicit human-approval gates. Apply the core stop rule to the affected task predicate: witnessed violation or unmet authorization falsifies corresponding admissibility, while missing evidence leaves it indeterminate. Preserve unusable-basis and outside-capability diagnoses. Refusal establishes neither failed fulfillment, non-performance nor no effects; observe undeclared or uncertain effects before dependent action.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced core stop contract is not supplied in full.

exceptions: Detailed implementation mechanisms for every phase are not required.
A phase may be inapplicable with a stated reason or deferred with its deferment and later owning surface named.

grounding.quote:
This rule is an ambiguity detector, not a demand that every requirement become
a release plan. If a phase is not applicable, say why. If the phase is unknown,
record a named gap such as `Gap:` or `Unanswered:`. Silent absence is not a
valid lifecycle answer.

When the lifecycle signal is missing, downstream design may not fill the gap by
local convention, implementation precedent, prompt prose, or test fixture. It
must reprice the appropriate constitutional surface or carry the ambiguity as
explicit, governed debt.

constraints.statement: Product definition and requirements must provide sufficient constitutional lifecycle signal for Design or explicitly record unresolved ambiguity. Product names boundary, intended use, release/install, live-use, observability and retirement/supersession posture where material to meaning. Requirements state invariant obligations governing build, assurance, release, deployment, use, telemetry, retirement, ownership, source truth, authority or downstream interpretation. Unknown phases require named gaps; silence is not an answer. Missing signal requires constitutional repricing or explicit governed debt, never local convention, implementation precedent, prompts or fixtures as substitute truth.

conditions: A change is substantive.

grounding.quote:
Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

constraints.statement: Every substantive change begins with intake triage, explicit declared change intent and lawful constitutional re-entry.

grounding.quote:
No bug, feature, issue, or other intake may bypass this triage by going
straight to code, tests, or release handling.

constraints.statement: Triage determines whether change is substantive, affected Product/scope, lawful class and re-entry, downstream surfaces/evidence to reprice/rederive/reprove, and release-scope fit or release-plan repricing. No intake bypasses it for code/tests/release. Diagnose realization defect, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate prediction and insufficient observation against current subject/outcome/observations/models; preserve unresolved alternatives and select observation before unjustified repair. Severity is consequence and priority response order, neither diagnosis nor repair grant. Triangulate applicable frames over the same subject/basis using material variables/relations/evidence; the exposing frame need not contain the cause, and renamed repeated analysis adds no causal evidence. Bind exact report, governing sources, workspace/external observations, retained results and assessment grant; reuse requires currentness. Computed treatment owns correction choice. Select smallest sufficient applicable frame configuration, localization where required, preserving independence/repair authority without imposing reviewer count/rounds. Classes: goal_reprice enters Goals and may propagate deeper where focus changes truth; intent_reprice enters Intent then Product/Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence; product_reprice keeps direction stable and enters Product onward; requirement_reprice keeps direction stable and enters Requirements onward; design_reframe keeps intent/requirements stable and enters Design onward; realization_refactor changes local implementation/procedure/configuration/attributes only and proves no upstream drift. Below-Goals smaller re-entry explicitly asserts no upstream constitutional change. Missing declared class is process drift; diagnostic findings do not grant mutation.

conditions: Causal diagnosis on a declared path is required.

grounding.quote:
A supported unique locus or jointly
necessary set maps to `satisfied` on that predicate. Unresolved alternatives,
an unsupported bounded frontier or a missing required reason maps to
`indeterminate`. Independently admissible evidence defeating the claimed
frontier gives `falsified`; an uninterpretable subject/causal basis gives
`invalid_basis`; diagnosis outside the evaluation scope/capability gives
`out_of_frame`. Apply the [core result contract](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra)
with actual performance and effects. Satisfaction of localization never
overwrites the original counterexample's result or establishes repair success.

constraints.statement: Product/design owners supply path and governing relations; adopted evaluation profiles apply this owner within selected tasks. Record subject, basis, frontier form/members, causal evidence, expected relations, observed counterexample and invalidated downstream claims. Do not collapse joint causes to an arbitrary owner or promote alternatives to joint cause. For the predicate that evidence establishes the stated earliest frontier: supported unique/joint necessary frontiers satisfy; unresolved alternatives, unsupported frontier or missing reason are indeterminate; admissible defeating evidence falsifies; uninterpretable subject/causal basis is invalid_basis; evaluation outside scope/capability is out_of_frame. Preserve actual performance/effects and original counterexample result. Localization establishes neither repair success nor authority for broader tests, compatibility repair, extra controllers or reinterpretation of unchanged upstream meaning; scope/design changes follow existing re-entry.

exceptions: A rename may preserve identity only when its owner supplies that relation.

grounding.quote:
C records its producer and procedure
revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes, reproduction relation, unknowns
and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence is an input state.

constraints.statement: Bind exact request/outcome, targets/effects, operation grant/lifetime, Product Definition/basis, baseline/available candidate, declared relations, accepted design, traces, evidence and rules; record producer/procedure revision, inputs/result/scope/source routes/reproduction/unknowns/invalidators. Missing candidate/evidence is an input state. Traverse declared source/ownership/dependency/composition/projection support; report reached layers/owners/bases, changed/unchanged/unknown relations, edges and unresolved frontier, including root/authority/grant change despite equal Public bytes. Semantic materiality uncertainty stays J. Enumerate the complete relevant serialized universe, including helpers/generated dependencies; report added/removed identities and every retained changed value/byte with exact before/after; default rename is removal+addition. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity or unavailable projection makes affected delta unknown; equal membership does not imply equal values. Join changes to accepted scope/traces/acceptance, distinguishing covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope; names/artifacts/digests alone establish no coverage. Current trace coverage is C, semantic sufficiency J. Apply only declared rules with sufficient facts, recording owners, premises/consequences, smallest lawful re-entry, next action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime; preserve conflicts/missing premises. Labels/filenames cannot select routes; rules that settle the issue need no invented residual judgment.

grounding.quote:
For either predicate, an unusable subject/basis gives `invalid_basis`, and an
evaluation outside its bound scope/capability gives `out_of_frame`; those
diagnoses differ from design scope excluding a relation. A missing reason gives
`indeterminate` under the core law, retaining independently established
counterevidence. C/J/O and change classes remain annotations and treatment
choices. A treatment determination evaluates its named rule premises; an
applied ruling uses the separate core decision predicate. Neither can be
inferred from delta or coverage labels alone.

constraints.statement: Comparison scope may include any supported state, including no change or no candidate. Difference predicate: authenticated changed=satisfied, complete equality/unchanged=falsified, unavailable/incomplete comparison=indeterminate. Accepted-design coverage predicate: current accepted scope/trace/acceptance= satisfied; complete absence/exclusion (missing/outside-scope)=falsified; undeciding missing/stale/ambiguous support=indeterminate. Unusable subject/basis yields invalid_basis; outside evaluation scope/capability yields out_of_frame, distinct from design exclusion. Missing reason preserves counterevidence and otherwise yields indeterminate. Treatment evaluates named premises; applied ruling has a separate decision predicate. Delta/nonconformance does not itself require contract change: if contract remains sufficient, reject or repair candidate within grant; re-enter actual owner for explicitly desired changed meaning or assessed insufficiency. C requires sufficient premises, unresolved meaning/necessity stays J, reserved decisions O; candidate behavior cannot author target law. Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance/promotion; an existing bounded grant may permit a cheapest useful discriminator, including first candidate, without conformance claim. Correct mistaken routes at smallest affected owner. Reuse checks request/candidate/basis/owner-root/projection/design trace-acceptance/rule/configuration/evidence; refresh before reliance, preserve predecessor/successor, original cause/attempted subject, effects, surviving facts and J dependencies; recompute wider frontier if independence is unproved.
constraints.uncertainty: Ticket carrier and recorded J/O continuity depend on unprovided TICKET_METHOD.md.

grounding.quote:
- the upstream surface remains sufficient for the downstream surface
- downstream artifacts do not contradict active upstream truth
- tests and qualification prove the active intended behavior rather than stale precedent

A review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change does not
discharge a missing required predicate in that conjunction.

constraints.statement: No gate closes with internally inconsistent affected active surfaces. Closure requires upstream sufficiency, downstream non-contradiction and tests/qualification of active intended behavior rather than stale precedent, together with all applicable obligations/rulings and no non-closure condition. Review events, aggregate passes, artifacts and status changes cannot discharge missing predicates. Core Result governs conjunction, not local artifact fitness. Ticket Method owns state/reuse carriers; Workspace and context owns applicability. In ticketed code/test mismatch, implementation is evidence, not authority; reconcile via admitted ticket, triage, lawful re-entry and governing requirement/design/module/graph/carrier/closure surface, using Ticket Method's test-case authority rule.

conditions: Work is within a Product-outcome-bearing work wave.

grounding.quote:
Acceptance exhausts only that instance and its declared
acceptance interval. It does not discharge an enduring guarantee, recurring
obligation, or broader Product family beyond the accepted instance. Further
work against the accepted instance is preservation, a named bounded
prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or a new change requiring lawful
repricing; it is not additional progress against the accepted instance.

constraints.statement: Judge progress/promotion against the same selected unresolved outcome and interval. Material-advance predicate is satisfied by established advance; prerequisite-only, preservation-only and observed regression falsify it; unmeasured/undecidable movement is indeterminate with basis/scope diagnoses. Separate readiness/preservation may satisfy. Prerequisites name enabled Product obligations and remain bounded. Acceptance exhausts selection for that exact instance/interval, preserving witnesses for regression and enduring/recurring obligations beyond it. Further work is preservation, bounded prerequisite to another admitted outcome or repriced new change. Next already-defined outcome is Goals sequencing; new/changed outcome meaning/scope re-enters Product. Evidence completion cannot select/enlarge/replace outcome. Explicit assurance capability as Product behavior can constitute progress; shared artifact output/evidence roles require separate declaration. Material growth needs selected unresolved outcome, admitted bounded prerequisite or admitted decision-discriminating experiment. These provisional grants do not enlarge outcomes, authorize downstream work, promote/close or waive Prime/design/safety/authority/release law. Work-wave owner or bounded proxy admits/renews in durable Goals/ticket authority with bound and exhaustion/falsification condition; ticket drafting/validation/status/prior admission do not renew. Acceptance, prerequisite discharge, experiment decision resolution, terminal condition, rejection, withdrawal, supersession, repricing or falsification ends basis; new material work then requires new owner/proxy admission. Retained behavior/evidence/regression/donor material grants no growth; consumer-owned salvage adopts only explicit semantics, not enclosing authority/dependencies/completion/work-selection power. Regression/unresolved gap blocks affected-path promotion until repair/reprice/owner acceptance, without globally blocking independently admitted parallel work or crediting it to this outcome. Outcome success is necessary delivery evidence, not full Product/release closure.

grounding.quote:
Each constraint must identify the semantic ambiguity it
removes and must contract enough of the admissible interpretation space to
justify the reasoning complexity it introduces. Rival authority, uncertainty
over failure classification, and evidence uncertainty count only where they
leave materially distinct admissible semantic, authority, outcome, or
acceptance interpretations. They measure or evidence the same interpretation
space removed; they are not independent proportional benefits.

constraints.statement: Each constraint identifies removed ambiguity and justifies introduced complexity by sufficient contraction of admissible meanings. Rival authority, failure/evidence uncertainty count only as materially distinct semantic/authority/outcome/acceptance alternatives, not additional benefits. Detailed algebra/Ontology/IACS/Prime/views may be proportional; even a short duplicate truth surface may not. Increased capability gives neither authority nor invariant/acceptance waiver. Coherent families may be justified once without per-clause rationale fields/receipts/audits. Divergent implementations/states/tests/reviews/joins are counterfactual evidence of removed alternatives, not a separate numerator; a bounded symbolic model within capacity can justify detailed design, but prior design removing no material alternatives is disproportionate. Additions duplicating truth, reconciliation or reasoning without reducing ambiguity are disproportionate; existing obligations should absorb detail where ownership/meaning survive. Repeated acquisition/context/hashing/activation/status/review/evidence serves identified change/decision/assurance; reuse needs exact applicability/invalidation, repetition proves neither validity nor independence. Material execution burden requires UP-019 operational qualification, not universal quotas or new accounting carriers. Default priority exposes/advances smallest supported Product path and highest-value likely failures; displacing defensive/prerequisite work identifies claim, evidence, bounded effort, return condition and Product consequence. Probability never waives authority, integrity, safety, retained release claims or hard stops; priority is not a global execution sequence/runtime.

conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.
exceptions: Optional profiles add duties only where adopted.

grounding.quote:
When construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker, the
method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's model,
prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout, or
orchestration runtime.

constraints.statement: Governing authorities select outcome, delegation and required independent assessment. Candidate bytes do not establish cone preservation; continuation retains useful work and observes current state and unresolved effects; bounded steps preserve affected outer relations. Construction or passing assessment cannot appoint acceptance authority. Human, machine and mixed bindings carry the same affected obligations. The described normative progression preserves separate construction, required independent live assessment, remedy decision, exact acceptance and next already-authorized action.

conditions: A bounded action is proposed.

grounding.quote:
Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, `STDO-UP-017` bounded-frame
conservation, `STDO-UP-016` transformation-admission completeness,
`STDO-UP-018` invariant-reconstruction sufficiency, and `STDO-UP-019`
computational-realization projection supply these design inputs. This section
consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.

constraints.statement: Apply the referenced Contract application to the action and identify all execution-binding coordinates. Acquire its constraint surface and material subject for current A, admitted Z, bounded transition and result-establishing observations. Where Design Module Method applies, consume UP-017 bounded-frame conservation, UP-016 transformation-admission completeness, UP-018 invariant-reconstruction sufficiency and UP-019 computational-realization projection as inputs, without creating a second design package.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced design laws and transformation contracts are outside the supplied source.

grounding.quote:
Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
does not block the bounded claim.

constraints.statement: Apply Support to the smallest coherent causal dependency cone. Material seams follow preservation support, not function/file/module/ticket/document boundaries. Record unrelated outside incompleteness as repricing input; it cannot block the bounded claim.

exceptions: Direct-human acceptance remains required where Product or release law requires it.

grounding.quote:
The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
Product or release law requires it.

constraints.statement: Required independent promotion assessment evaluates exact live realization, computational binding, authority paths, proof and installed subject, not constructor summary alone; configuration binds shared independence without actor-count prescription. A governing relation must declare proxy acceptance/advancement authority; proxies may accept preservation, require repair, reject violations and advance already-authorized action, but cannot change Product meaning, requirements, authority or accepted design. With accepted basis/cone/envelope/re-entry conditions, every transition needs no new human ceremony. One capable context with sufficient work authority, exact intake and operation grant may enter directly as constructor/Writer without Executive appointment. Coordination is selected for material context/authority/capability/independence need, not role names. Direct entry preserves contract admission, smallest lawful carrier, assessment and reserved decisions; it grants no self-acceptance at another owner's boundary. One grant may cover declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; record role transitions in existing carrier, with no new grant/rehash solely for status. Material operation/subject/territory/authority/validity changes require resolved binding before effect; Executive mutation restrictions remain.
constraints.uncertainty: Executive mutation restrictions are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote:
| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | `satisfied` |
| `local_repair`, demonstrated counterexample | a demonstrated defect defeats the claim while the governing relation remains coherent | `falsified` |
| `local_repair`, inadequate proof | missing or defective proof leaves the candidate claim undecided; the evidence supports a local proof repair | `indeterminate` |
| `re_enter`, defeated candidate | the intended candidate cannot satisfy an interpretable current contract without an owning-layer change | `falsified` |
| `re_enter`, unusable governing basis | the governing requirements cannot supply a coherent interpretation for this assessment | `invalid_basis` |
| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | `falsified` |
| any proposed disposition, missing required reason or support | its qualified condition above is not established and no independently admissible evidence decides the candidate predicate | `indeterminate` |

constraints.statement: For the exact cone-preservation predicate: supported accept=satisfied; local repair for demonstrated candidate defect under coherent law=falsified; local proof repair leaving candidate undecided=indeterminate; re-entry because candidate cannot satisfy interpretable contract without owner change=falsified; incoherent governing requirements=invalid_basis; candidate violation or undisposed competing truth path supporting reject=falsified. Missing reason/support gives indeterminate only absent independently decisive evidence; preserve raw remedy as non-deciding support and authenticated counterevidence/basis/scope diagnosis. Governing-requirement coherence is admission; candidate/design alignment is evaluated. Contradictory design alone does not invalidate interpretable requirements; proof failure can falsify proof without falsifying implementation. Core verdict/conjunction never selects a remedy; supported cause and authority are required, and useful authorized repair is not forbidden by verdict alone. Separate applied Dispose decision can be satisfied by lawful reject without candidate counterexample and never overwrites assessment. Global correctness preserves every affected global relation without whole-Product proof per action. Repeated rejection at unchanged boundary requires reassessing frame altitude, cone, common components, design/code placement and authority sufficiency; no numeric rejection threshold, review-round count or state machine is imposed, and unchanged failed iteration cannot be treated as closure.

grounding.quote:
A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.

constraints.statement: Reviewable transitions identify all declared evidence coordinates, with consumer-chosen representation and no specification/design/admission authority. Focused proof binds affected obligations, assertion/execution dependencies, supported exclusions, newly uncovered cases and mandatory gates using referenced change-impact/risk laws. It supports the intended claim; cheap falsification of weaker conditions cannot close stronger claims. Retain applicable evidence on original subject through required new applicability relation; compare selection and reassessment cost together. Whole-candidate qualification stays at its declared boundary or moves earlier for affected risk, uncertain impact or mandatory gates. Where incidental process-state loss is material, durable/reconstructable authority needs proof destroying/excluding that authority and comparing reconstructed semantic outcomes, not same-process proof alone.

grounding.quote:
Continuation applies Contract application's Currentness condition to the next
action over the continuing workspace, retaining applicable partial work and
evidence. An ordinary restart selects no rebuild from the original A.
If a proposed recovery instead discards or rebuilds work, identify why repair
of retained work is insufficient, which obligations and evidence survive,
which causal assumptions change and which existing operation grant permits
that effect. Reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction.

constraints.statement: Exact checkpoint acceptance permits next already-authorized bounded action without renewed human approval but never expands outcome/cone. Preservation checkpoints name predecessor, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence under existing grant. Continuation applies Currentness and retains applicable partial work/evidence; restart does not select original-A rebuilding. Discard/rebuild recovery identifies why repair is insufficient, surviving obligations/evidence, changed causal assumptions and existing grant for effects. Churn alone proves neither movement nor noncompliance; newly discovered distance changes forecast, not implementation progress. Paperwork/code/test/commit/review quantities alone are not Product progress. Consumers may derive projections, not infer a supplied numeric algorithm. Protocol violation includes unreconstructable execution context, report substituting for independent live evidence, proxy overreach, outside incompleteness blocking a closed cone, same-process proof for material cross-process authority, or rejected activity reported as accepted progress.

grounding.quote:
Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis
identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance after
preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor and
currentness law for that basis or re-enters derivation and validation without
effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a design-declared coherent
composite basis. Independently valid judgments without that relation cannot
establish admission; retain the basis or join diagnosis under the map below.

constraints.statement: Each owner independently derives and validates the complete material relation from authoritative inputs, preserving Support and required independence. Mutation, rollback, changed authority/basis, expired validity and actual trust-boundary crossing require applicable validation before reliance/effect, even unchanged facts across trust boundaries. Assertions and unsupported prior success establish nothing; reuse retains owner responsibility and separately required judgment. Exact admission-valid basis persists through admission; possible post-preflight advancement requires declared predecessor/currentness commit condition or effect-free re-derivation. Owners use equal or design-declared coherent composite basis. Validate every participant/join before any effect; no subset or nested constituent is admitted truth. Complete transition commits semantically once on exact basis, or none on failure/interruption; mechanism, participant count, internal evaluation order and lawful reuse remain implementation-owned. Every supported direct/composite/nested boundary preserves the law; partial results and competing same-scope paths cannot substitute. Fresh reconstruction/replay over same basis reproduces relation, basis and complete outcome/refusal semantically. Omitted seams/participants/joins, asserted completeness, unidentified/stale/incoherent basis, uncontrolled advancement, premature effects, exposed subsets, divergent reconstruction or competing authority falsify the law.

grounding.quote:
Admission satisfaction, actual semantic commit and atomicity are separate
claims. `Without effect` is a required refusal observation: report `not_started`
only when no requested transition effect began, and retain observed `partial`,
`reverted` or `unknown` effects on their actual boundaries. An observed subset
falsifies complete-or-none publication even if preflight admission satisfied;
unobserved publication remains unresolved and requires observation before
dependent re-entry. A refusal label cannot erase an effect that occurred.

constraints.statement: Preserve admitted/refused/effect-free re-entry outcomes separately from assessment. Complete established relation/conditions/joins=satisfied, supporting assessed admission but not commit. Demonstrated interpretable violation, forged identity/authority, stale predecessor, defeated grant or omitted required participant/join=falsified. Unresolved ambiguity/support/currentness/reason=indeterminate. Uninterpretable/contradictory subject/basis, including mixed bases without interpretable composite=invalid_basis. Outside scope/capability=out_of_frame, leaving wider obligation open. Under interpretable composite, incompatible participant/join falsifies and missing evidence is indeterminate; coherent differing valid bases are not failures. Conjunction retains authenticated failures beside uncovered/invalid contributions; arbitrary supported predecessor states and supported forms use the same contract. Unsupported-form not_applicable instead assesses exclusion: supported exclusion satisfies, supported inclusion falsifies, unresolved applicability is indeterminate with basis/scope diagnoses; it never substitutes for admission assessment. Authorized decisions are separate and not granted by assessment. Refusal requires actual no-effect observation: not_started only if no transition effect began; retain partial/reverted/unknown effects. Observed subset falsifies atomic publication even after satisfied preflight; unobserved publication stays unresolved and needs observation before dependent re-entry.

conditions: Cases fall within the accepted design's supported input, state and operating/threat model.
exceptions: Representative atomic-failure observations suffice only with design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface.
Unsupported forms require design-grounded not_applicable; excluded threats alone create neither acceptance predicates nor defensive-work requirements.

grounding.quote:
For an indivisible commit unit, the atomic test establishes that boundary and
observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation
failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure evidence. A
standing claim is false if an owner or supported boundary is omitted, a
materially distinct partial-failure boundary lacks an observation or declared
coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or manufactured refusal, or fresh
reconstruction does not compare the complete semantic result.

constraints.statement: Each case reports its actual admission/applicability/publication predicate through the owning map, without new conjunction or no-effect inference. Direct relation is completely derived/validated/admitted once; every supported composite/nested constituent and owner obeys the same law with no weaker/competing path. Reachable forged identity/membership/equality/authority and unresolved enclosing participant/join/seam/identity ambiguity are refused without effect; exclusion needs owning authority, not helper incapacity. Stale input is refused; advancing basis causes effect-free re-entry. Incoherent composite retains invalid_basis, or defeated/undecided join result for interpretable composite, with admission withheld and absence of effect verified. Competing same-scope authority cannot establish transition. Fresh-process reconstruction and exact replay reproduce relation/basis/outcome/refusal. After successful validation, observe failure/interruption at every materially distinct commit/publication boundary capable of exposing a subset and fresh-reconstruct complete-or-none outcome. For indivisible units establish boundary and test immediately both sides; final-validation failure cannot replace post-validation atomic evidence. Missing owner/boundary/coverage, weaker helper/manufactured refusal or incomplete semantic reconstruction falsifies standing claim.

conditions: A core interface migration is undertaken.
exceptions: Bounded Product-slice proof follows the separately stated path-relative promotion rule.

grounding.quote:
- change the authoritative core contract first
- ban bridge code for that contract family as an authoritative surface
- audit every producer and every consumer of the impacted interface
- migrate each producer and consumer to the new contract
- chase every downstream effect until no superseded closure law remains
- run complete migration-closure proof only after the migration wave is
  complete; bounded Product-slice proof remains governed by the path-relative
  promotion rule below

constraints.statement: Change authoritative core first, disallow authoritative bridge surfaces, audit and migrate every affected producer/consumer, follow downstream effects until no superseded closure law remains, and perform complete closure proof only after the wave completes. One changed component cannot prove preservation across unexamined producers/consumers/views. Mixed old/new writers, divergent runtime/reporting carriers, authoritative compatibility aliases, second-truth projections or passing tests over split architecture cannot be declared complete.

exceptions: Supported explicitly disjoint compatibility scopes retain lawful latitude.

grounding.quote:
Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit selection by the human authority
owning the affected Product boundary. The selection compares re-adoption with
bounded evolution across Product value, feedback latency, authority risk,
reversibility, total cost, and retained predecessor semantics. It also states a
