bounded abort or re-entry condition. Implementation scale or architectural
preference alone does not select re-adoption.

constraints.statement: When both strategies are lawful/feasible and a working predecessor reaches admitted outcome without competing/ambiguous authority, supported-path evolution is rebuttably presumed; never require unsafe/inadmissible predecessor or mechanisms explicitly superseded by Product. Core-interface evolution uses Inside-Out Hard-Break. Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit affected-Product human owner selection comparing value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained semantics, plus bounded abort/re-entry condition; scale/preference alone is insufficient. Both strategies prohibit proxy partial acceptance substitutes and silently authoritative bridges/fallbacks. Promotion requires one governing authority over full causal closure: every admitted entrypoint, producer, consumer, resolver, fallback, state, event, projection and proof capable of affecting interpretation/closure. Old/new admissibility for the same request/fact/identity/state/projection is competing authority and blocks promotion. Residual material outside promoted path may defer only if explicitly non-authoritative for it or governing a specified disjoint deterministically routed scope, unable to falsify current/retained claims, and bounded by migration/qualification/release disposition. Tests are proof/leak detection, not migration plans. Intermediate slice promotion requires singular path and lawful residual deferment, names Product plus all causal live requirements/design/retained predecessor claims and never closes migration or waives retirement; ticket/review text cannot narrow these. Migration activity never renews accepted slice growth: admitted removal/demotion/closure proof may continue within bound without progress claim; new producer/consumer growth needs another live UP-013 basis.

conditions: Every core interface migration.

grounding.quote:
Every old path must then be classified as one of:

- `remove`
- `replace`
- `re-authorize`
- `temporary scaffolding`

Temporary scaffolding is lawful only if it is explicitly non-authoritative and
scheduled for removal before closure.

constraints.statement: Explicitly declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint Product or compatibility scope and deterministic routing; new authoritative contract; superseded contract/surface; new authoritative closure law; full old/new producer and consumer sets; and every derived projection/report/status/proof surface. Classify every old path remove, replace, re-authorize or temporary scaffolding. Scaffolding is lawful only if explicitly non-authoritative and scheduled for removal before closure.

conditions: A core interface migration is underway.
exceptions: The only stated lawful exception is an intentionally specified, explicitly bounded compatibility feature retained in the live Product and clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth.

grounding.quote:
The only lawful exception is an explicit compatibility feature retained as part
of the live product. In that case the compatibility path must be:

- intentionally specified
- explicitly bounded
- clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth

constraints.statement: No authoritative compatibility alias, silent fallback identity law, bridge accepted as new contract, old reader/writer authoritative for an outcome now governed by new contract, or proxy/partial interface masquerading as completion may remain.

conditions: Runtime, reporting, status, topology or proof views project the authoritative carrier.

grounding.quote:
This migration binding requires one governing closure relation across
those views. A different carrier or closure law that permits conflicting
determinations, a view that independently closes an open source, or a view
retaining superseded closure law leaves the migration incomplete, even when the
authoritative carrier itself can close.

constraints.statement: Apply faithful projection with one governing closure relation across views. Conflicting carrier/closure determinations, independent view closure of open source or retained superseded closure law leave migration incomplete even when authoritative carrier can close.

conditions: Inside-Out Hard-Break strategy is selected.
exceptions: Downstream exploration may exist as isolated non-authoritative work before source publication/admission.

grounding.quote:
- downstream exploration may exist only as isolated non-authoritative work; it
  must not land in public runtime, projection, prompt, report, or proof entry
  points until the source carrier is published and admitted
- a downstream projection ticket must not close while the source-carrier ticket
  it depends on is still open
- dependency direction must reflect this order explicitly so the ticket set
  exposes the migration wave from source truth to downstream read models

constraints.statement: Proceed outward from new authoritative source. Discover full best-guess family before closure proof: producers, consumers, projections, prompts, reports, wrappers, replay, ingest, bootstrap and proof. Producer/source work precedes consumer/projection/prompt/dossier/report/review hardening. Exploration cannot land in public runtime/projection/prompt/report/proof entrypoints before source publication and admission. Dependent projection tickets cannot close while source tickets remain open; explicit dependency direction exposes this order.

conditions: An inside-out migration break is performed.
exceptions: Specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping Product/compatibility scopes may coexist while migration remains open.

grounding.quote:
1. publish or admit the new deepest authoritative source carrier
2. deliberately sever one old authoritative seam
3. keep that seam broken
4. repair outward from source truth to consumers, then projections, then
   prompts/reports, then proof surfaces
5. run negative proof that the severed seam is rejected rather than merely
   unused

constraints.statement: The ordered wave does not permit dual truth over the same request/fact/identity/state/projection. For each break publish/admit deepest new source, sever one old authoritative seam, keep it broken, repair outward through consumers then projections then prompts/reports then proof, and negatively prove rejection rather than mere non-use. Tests may find missed interfaces but cannot replace inventory; discoveries remain in the same wave unless explicitly repriced upward. Wrappers/fallbacks/projections/prompts that re-enable the severed seam are defects.

exceptions: Bounded Product-slice proof may establish the exact intermediate outcome allowed by path-relative promotion, never complete migration closure.

grounding.quote:
- tests that pass only because bridge-state semantics remain alive do not count
  as closure proof
- green local tests do not overrule a split architecture
- migration-closure proof belongs after migration, not during a partially
  migrated state
- per-break proof must show the severed old seam is rejected or fails closed
  before downstream hardening can count as progress

constraints.statement: Complete migration-closure proof is invalid while producers/consumers remain split across old/new contracts. Bridge-dependent passes and green local tests do not close split architecture. Complete proof follows migration; each break must demonstrate old-seam rejection or fail-closed behavior before downstream hardening counts as progress.

conditions: Closure is claimed across the declared affected scope.
exceptions: A superseded mechanism may remain for a justified distinct supported responsibility; enduring cold reconstruction or independent oracle obligations need no invented expiry.

grounding.quote:
Retention bears the burden. Each retained superseded mechanism identifies a
current supported obligation, owner, purpose, execution scope and material cost.
Temporary compatibility or comparison work has an expiry or removal trigger;
existing tests, an oracle label or nominal demotion do not justify duplicate
production responsibility. A required cold reconstruction route or independent
test oracle may serve an enduring distinct obligation without an invented
expiry. Where an obligation survives replacement, identify its surviving owner;
where it has no governing basis, no replacement guard is required. Retirement
inside a closed affected cone does not await unrelated whole-Product closure.

constraints.statement: All authoritative producers write and consumers read new contract; superseded paths are retired except justified distinct responsibility; projections derive from same truth; runtime/reporting/topology/proof share one closure law; no temporary scaffolding remains in acceptance. Otherwise wave remains active, not completed refactor. Every retained mechanism names current obligation, owner, purpose, execution scope and material cost; temporary compatibility/comparison has expiry/removal trigger. Tests, oracle label or nominal demotion do not justify duplicate production. Surviving obligations name owners; absent governing obligation requires no replacement guard. Closed-cone retirement need not await unrelated whole-Product closure. Accepted slices name their exact closure and visibly retain open migration, never implying migration/qualification/release closure.

grounding.quote:
Use [Release identities](RELEASE_METHOD.md#release-identities) and
[Selector and consumer adoption](RELEASE_METHOD.md#selector-and-consumer-adoption)
to bind an exact operative cut and distinguish it from discovery.

constraints.statement: Bind exact operative cut using Release Method identities and selector/adoption law, distinct from discovery. Immutable feature acceptance belongs to release metadata/evaluation; current constitutional/shared-realization surfaces use role, boundary and status rather than release-line branding. Release Method retains criteria, publication and advancement decisions.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced Release Method rules are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
This evidence family assumes F1–F4 and F6: a witness establishes only its bound
property, and changed evidence does not author changed meaning or permission.

constraints.statement: A witness establishes only its bound property; changed evidence authors neither meaning nor permission. Construction assurance owns obligation→assertion→observation→supported conclusion; Contract application binds operation and Faithful projection binds views. UP-001 adds explicit proof-target/weaker-property exclusions, UP-008 separate bases, and UP-022 composite boundary/fresh-constructor/exposure conditions. Evaluators must not substitute their own target for the claim owner's property/scope.

conditions: Reliance is placed on load-bearing proof.

grounding.quote:
Packaging, syntax, compilation, file presence, invocation, or local behavior
must not substitute for semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release, or
end-to-end proof merely because the weaker property is easier to measure.

constraints.statement: Before witness selection bind exact subject/property/basis, claim relation, nearest weaker excluded property and falsification condition. State supported necessary/sufficient relation, required conjunction and distinguishing observation. Interpretive fidelity and observed checker behavior are separate obligations. Missing binding leaves discovery, not closure-grade proof; easier packaging/syntax/compilation/presence/invocation/local-behavior evidence cannot replace semantic/authority/installed/release/end-to-end proof.

grounding.quote:
Evidence or view changes do not themselves change meaning. Semantic change
requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance; a
broad digest may conservatively invalidate review without proving that every
semantic relation changed.

constraints.statement: Apply Currentness to verdict and Faithful projection to view. Evidence/view changes alone do not change meaning. Semantic change requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance. Broad digest invalidation may conservatively reopen review without proving every semantic relation changed.

exceptions: Expected/reference outcomes are optional non-authoritative evidence when existing and applicable; reference equivalence is required only if governing basis requires it.
Pre-freeze withholding applies where earlier exposure would compromise reconstructive independence.

grounding.quote:
Semantic equivalence to
that reference is required only where the governing basis requires it. A lawful
alternative construction permitted by the basis satisfies its semantic
conformance predicate when the declared evidence establishes it, through the
core result record. Subjective similarity
to the basis or reference is insufficient to establish semantic conformance or
equivalence. Byte or structural identity, unique derivation, determinism, and
incumbent equality are not generic comparison criteria. A construction outside
the declared competence or configuration envelope cannot indict generic method
sufficiency.

constraints.statement: Evaluate the authoritative composite subject; per-carrier/weaker-subject proof leaves other obligations open. Mechanical enforcement requires observed executable/reproducible predicate and witness through ordinary declared assurance path; planned/spec-only harness stays planned or open. Quantifier/population/scope cannot exceed evidence; generalization needs declared inference, comparable population, counterexample treatment and governing evidence; later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until superseded/withdrawn/requalified. Generic sufficiency consumes probabilistic-work, UP-020, reconstruction and independent-assessment law, with UP-007 review/promotion. Declare competent constructor envelope and independent evaluator authority/basis/comparison; use only ordinary declared inputs. Withhold compromising material references, exemplars/incumbents, author memory and ad hoc rescue until frozen construction. After freeze compare under mandatory governing semantics, never constructor authority or result-adjusted comparison. Supported lawful alternatives can satisfy; subjective similarity, byte/structural identity, unique derivation, determinism or incumbent equality cannot replace semantic proof. Out-of-envelope construction cannot indict generic method. Post-exposure revision is declared method constituent with qualification boundary or new subject, never retroactive pass. No actor type/count, review rounds, engine, prompt or orchestration prescribed. Changed guidance is qualified against source-derived behavior including permissions/exclusions/invalidators; native-use claims require ordinary actor via declared entry/context. Digest/index proves identity/structure, not fidelity/usability; mechanical/operational claims need executable observations and applicable UP-019 workload assumptions. Violating these boundaries falsifies the law.

exceptions: Constraints, governance and verification-infrastructure requirements may need other evidence in addition to or instead of end-to-end scenarios.

grounding.quote:
Without an adequate
scenario, that layer has not demonstrated the capability. A failed scenario
supplies a discrepancy to [Universal Intake Triage](#universal-intake-triage);
the failure alone does not distinguish a realization defect, inadequate
governing meaning, inaccurate prediction or an inadequate scenario, oracle or
observation. The scenario must expose operational behavior rather than merely
compare the specification's words with other words.

constraints.statement: Words in requirements/design alone do not demonstrate capabilities; adequate concrete scenarios test operational behavior from intent to realization, not text-to-text similarity. Failure supplies an intake discrepancy, not a diagnosis of implementation, governing meaning, prediction, scenario, oracle or observation. Scenarios primarily validate capabilities and operational behavior without replacing requirement categories.

exceptions: An explicitly equivalent isolated composed-product proof lane may be called UAT/acceptance.

grounding.quote:
Under this method, only sandbox tests or an explicitly equivalent isolated
composed-product proof lane may be called UAT / acceptance tests.

A sandbox test must exercise the deployed, installed, or otherwise runnable
product form through declared application, public, runtime, or control surfaces.
It must be driven by a requirement-sourced scenario or acceptance case. Direct
source-level unit tests, helper tests, and module integration tests may be
valuable proof, but they are not UAT and cannot close user acceptance by
themselves.

constraints.statement: Every executable proof surface declares authority. Ticketed proof derives from admitted ticket/triage/re-entry and cited law, never current implementation expectations. Each lane binds expectation to owning source/justified interpretation and execution to subject/checker/environment/observations; class labels establish neither fidelity nor independent failure causes. Implementation-derived regression retains local scope without upstream acceptance promotion; shared derivations may serve declared families. Design/module tests derive design, module ownership, IACS/equivalent inventory, diagrams if present and boundary fail-closed law; unit tests belong here, and module integration/negative/fail-closed tests may when targeting designed boundaries. UAT derives requirements, acceptance criteria, scenarios/use cases and Product release/qualification claims. Sandbox exercises deployed/installed/runnable Product through declared public/application/runtime/control surfaces under requirement-sourced scenario; source/helper/module tests alone cannot close user acceptance. Harnessed sandbox exercises full composed path with fake/recorded/injected/deterministic worker/result, proving composition/orchestration/control/projection/archive/scenario wiring and suited to reproducibility. Live sandbox crosses real configured worker/tool/agent/service/transport and returns result/evaluation/provenance/projection evidence. For live-dependent claims semantic/unit/module/harnessed green are necessary but insufficient for live acceptance. Integration denotes breadth, unit design scope, sandbox composed acceptance, live real external transport; a live-named status view is not live UAT. Alternate filenames/runner labels map each lane to taxonomy before closure.

exceptions: External evidence is permitted through a checked-in minimal fixture, a manifest naming source/version/acquisition or binding, or reclassification as harnessed/live sandbox, reference comparison or optional local evidence rather than required semantic closure.

grounding.quote:
For the Product property the diagnostic is `indeterminate` when the fixture
absence leaves evidence insufficient, retaining independent counterevidence or
basis/scope diagnoses. A separately assessed `required fixture is available`
predicate may be `falsified` when absence is established. Preserve whether the
Product evaluation was undertaken; an unavailable fixture is not by itself a
Product counterexample.

constraints.statement: Required closure lanes are reproducible from declared source. Unit/semantic/module-design lanes cannot depend on undeclared paths, sibling workspaces, operator homes or mutable external fixtures. Missing external fixtures fail with governed diagnostic naming fixture authority/lane, never masquerading as Product semantic failure. Insufficient Product evidence yields indeterminate while retaining independent counterevidence/basis/scope diagnoses; established fixture absence may falsify a separate availability predicate. Preserve whether Product evaluation occurred; absence alone is no Product counterexample.

conditions: A requirement is live.

grounding.quote:
No live requirement is considered fully proved if it relies only on informal
operator confidence, ambient habit, or an unlabeled test corpus.

constraints.statement: Every live requirement has written, traceable testcase authority suited to its truth. Informal confidence, habit or unlabeled test corpus alone never establishes full proof.

conditions: A requirement claims meaningful system behavior.

grounding.quote:
Features are not proved by isolated assertions alone.

Where a requirement claims meaningful system behavior, the proving surface should
be a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered set of testcases that exercises that
behavior through a coherent sequence rather than as disconnected fragments.

constraints.statement: Isolated assertions alone do not prove features. The proving surface should use a scenario bundle or equivalent coherent ordered testcases, showing feature/use-case boundary, proving sequence and expected significant-step outcomes. Scenarios pressure intent/design and are the stated best source for significant code/control paths; this recommendation is not strengthened to a mandatory bundle format.

conditions: A system has an installable or runnable development form.

grounding.quote:
That proof should prefer:

- fresh sandbox or equivalent isolated environment
- installed or built development artifact
- execution through the same declared entry/control/runtime surfaces the real
  product uses

Direct source-level or unit-level checks may remain useful, but they do not
replace installed-dev proof of the system under test.

constraints.statement: Decisive proof runs against installed development as independent/externalized target, not source tree alone. It should prefer a fresh sandbox/equivalent isolation, installed/built artifact and real declared entry/control/runtime surfaces. Useful source/unit checks cannot replace this proof; the preferences remain recommendations.

grounding.quote:
If the significant paths are not declared, scenario coverage cannot be judged.
If they are declared but not exercised, the behavior is not fully proved.

constraints.statement: The proving surface must declare and exercise significant paths for the claimed behavior. Usual success/rejection/control/integration/recovery families apply where relevant, without universal every-branch coverage. Undeclared paths prevent coverage judgment; declared but unexercised paths prevent full proof.

conditions: A requirement family is live.
exceptions: A path, filename or packaging rule may be requirement truth when itself constitutional.

grounding.quote: Requirements should also avoid freezing concrete realization choices prematurely. Unless a path, filename, or packaging rule is itself part of the constitutional truth, those choices belong to design rather than the requirement surface.

constraints.statement: Every live requirement family shall be categorized by its kind of truth. All four categories remain constitutional, without implying priority or user visibility. Requirements cover WHAT, Design HOW with ADRs as durable form, and scenarios operational capability meaning. Not every requirement should become a marketed feature; guarantees/governance/verification remain valid forms. Requirements should avoid premature concrete choices; non-constitutional paths/names/packaging belong to Design.

exceptions: Accepted relations may reuse exact current basis and sufficient evidence after applicability/invalidation checks; unchanged accepted views need not be recreated.

grounding.quote:
For an already accepted relation, reconstruction may reuse its exact current
basis and sufficient evidence after checking applicability and invalidation.
Reconstructability requires a correct reconstruction route, not its execution
at every use. It grants no restart authority and does not excuse stale success.
The claim determines the reconstruction span; a local selected function does
not require recreating the whole Product. New material counterexamples still
challenge the affected relation. Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, it
owns design-view coverage, its material-change gate and unchanged-boundary
reuse; this litmus does not waive that gate or require recreating unchanged
accepted views.

constraints.statement: Specification-driven status requires ordered reconstructability by competent teams, not unique output. Failure Goals→Intent diagnoses unclear/contradictory/non-concrete Goals; Intent→Product vague/contradictory/non-concrete Intent; Product→Requirements underspecified/contradictory/undecomposable Product; Requirements→Design underspecified/contradictory/accidentally implementation-bound Requirements; Requirements+Design→Realization incomplete/ambiguous/non-operational Design for binding. ADRs/design provide governing realization decisions. Hidden major ambiguity means upstream insufficiency even if an artifact can be produced. Correct route, not repeated execution, is required; no restart grant or stale-success excuse follows. Claim bounds reconstruction span; new counterexamples challenge affected relations. Applicable Design Module coverage/material-change/reuse gates remain effective.

exceptions: Upstream constitutional constraints can determine stack/carrier/runtime; constitutionally necessary filenames or placement may belong in requirements.

grounding.quote:
- requirements may say that authoritative bootstrap or control surfaces must be present, carry bare axioms, and route to the canonical method
- design decides whether those surfaces are entry documents, embedded blocks, standalone compiled artifacts, or another lawful topology

If filenames and placement are hardcoded in requirements without constitutional necessity, the requirement surface has absorbed design detail and made re-derivation harder.

constraints.statement: Requirements specify necessary control/delivery surfaces; Design selects concrete mechanism. Unconstrained technology/stack/carrier/runtime choice is Design, not separate upstream authority. Requirements may demand bootstrap/control presence, bare axioms and canonical routing; Design chooses lawful document/block/artifact/topology. Hardcoding names/placement without constitutional necessity absorbs design detail and impairs re-derivation.

allowed: Adopt an available optional profile or define a project configuration.
Express the accepted declaration entirely in source-linked prose; the copyable template is optional.
Several agents may activate overlapping subsets; one agent may activate different frames over time.
forbidden: Treating the template as authority or requiring schema, axiomatic representation, prompt framework or runtime frame engine to use the method.

Leaving template placeholders in the adopted declaration: replace every placeholder with exact Product identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results and invalidators, then admit under existing authority.
Inferring activation, authority or frame membership from profile availability or nominal identity.

grounding.quote:
An accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis may be expressed entirely as
source-linked prose. The starter at
`templates/PROJECT_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS_TEMPLATE.md` projects this binding
law into one copyable shape. The template is not authority and no schema,
axiomatic representation, prompt framework, or runtime frame engine is needed
to use the method. An adopting Product replaces every placeholder with its own
exact identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results, and invalidation
conditions, then admits that completed declaration under existing authority.

allowed: Reuse computational calculus across tenants/environments when bindings satisfy its laws and common obligations.
Use software, hardware, people, organisations or mixtures; language/tool/team differences alone do not demand a new calculus.
Resolve ticketing bindings to directories, repository resources, trackers, API endpoints or Product-scoped queries; sprint manifests are optional.
Keep a human-readable or generated Tenant Registry companion without independent authority.
forbidden: Defining computation solely by machine architecture.
Using realization convenience to weaken required authority, human decisions, independence, failure or recovery.

grounding.quote:
A computational calculus may be reused across tenants and execution environments
where its bindings satisfy its laws and the common obligations. A different
language, tool or team does not by itself require a different calculus. Author
identity, actor identity and operation kind remain distinct; neither identity
determines operation kind. A person performing a procedure is not thereby making
a human adjudication. An a_c representation neither selects the executor nor
proves realisation conformance by passing structural validation.

allowed: Batch work, coordinate tickets/iterations, price proof cost and force close review under existing Goals, Intent, Product, Requirements and Design authority.
Use local visible bounded repayable proof escrow, especially for projection or UX iteration, subject to governing law.
forbidden: Creating, superseding, weakening or overriding constitutional authority through sprint control.
Treating deferred compliance or sprint close as automatic acceptance.

grounding.quote:
A sprint may batch work, coordinate tickets or iteration entries, price proof
cost, and force close review under existing Goals, Intent, Product Definition,
Requirements, and Design authority. It must not create, supersede, weaken, or
override that authority.

allowed: Carry or decide ambiguity by lawful probabilistic processing when declared project policy permits.
Escalate to explicit human adjudication when project policy requires.
Choose different declared risk appetites, with lower appetite escalating more major ambiguity and higher appetite permitting more bounded probabilistic decisions.
forbidden: Using silent convenience to set escalation thresholds.
Leaving major ambiguity or its handling unrecorded.
Waiving non-optional hard stops by risk appetite.

grounding.quote:
- ambiguity may be carried or decided by lawful probabilistic processing when
  project policy allows it
- ambiguity may be escalated to explicit human adjudication when project policy
  requires it
- the threshold between those actions is determined by declared risk appetite,
  not by silent convenience

Projects may therefore choose different ambiguity-handling policies. A lower
risk appetite escalates more major ambiguity to explicit human judgment. A
higher risk appetite permits more bounded probabilistic decision-making. In either
case, the ambiguity and the decision must be recorded.

allowed: Vary internal decomposition, search, collaboration, tools and synthesis when variation cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety or release property.
Justify one coherent constraint family once without repeated per-clause or per-consumer rationale artifacts.
forbidden: Inferring authority or waived invariants/acceptance from increased capability.
Treating repetition as validity or independence.

grounding.quote:
The method does not prescribe an internal decomposition, search,
collaboration, tool, or synthesis procedure when variation in that procedure
cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety, or release
property. Increased agent capability may enlarge the bounded relation an agent
can resolve; it does not grant authority, weaken an invariant, or waive
acceptance.

The owning law may justify one coherent constraint family once. This does not
require a rationale field, receipt, or repeated audit for every clause or
consumer application.

allowed: Promote an intermediate Product slice while enclosing migration stays open when its complete acceptance path has singular authority and residual material meets the explicit deferment law.
Retain specified disjoint Product/compatibility scope with deterministic routing, no falsification of retained/current claims and bounded disposition.
Continue already-admitted removal, demotion and migration-closure proof within the existing bound without additional Product-progress claim.
forbidden: Using a single successful trace as proof of singular authority across causal closure.
Narrowing Product/requirement/design/predecessor authority through ticket or review wording.
Renewing exhausted growth authority through active migration/ticket status.

grounding.quote:
Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims. An
intermediate Product outcome may be promoted while its enclosing migration
remains open only when the outcome's acceptance path has singular authority and
the residual implementation satisfies the deferment rule above. That promotion
does not close the migration or waive its final retirement criteria. The
slice's identity and acceptance criteria derive from Product plus every causally
applicable live requirement, accepted design relation, and retained predecessor
claim. Ticket or review wording cannot narrow that authority away.

limitations: This is bounded source interpretation under the selected STDO 2.5.1-rc.2 basis, not semantic acceptance, execution, installed qualification or a completeness judgment.

No external files, skills, graph endpoints or referenced laws were acquired. F1–F6; shared Support, Currentness, Result and decision contracts; transformation specializations; Reference Frame Method/profile/template; Release Method; Ticket Method; UX refinements; Design Module Method; and earlier/later SPEC_METHOD sections remain unresolved beyond meanings explicitly restated here.
Graphify discovery is not treated as normative evidence. Out-of-scope graph nodes and unprovided source sections are not reconstructed from labels or connectivity.

Judgments, traversals and transformations are described as subject concepts and constraints only. Their executable populations remain empty in the adapter; this schema provides no executable semantics, traversal traces, decision proofs or workflow instantiation.

Several concepts intentionally represent grouped source-defined categories or role maps. The records preserve their stated distinctions without asserting actual Product identities, authority grants, observed effects or evaluated outcomes.

Repeated headings, separators and illustrative repetitions are compacted; no represented Product, frame declaration, candidate, release, fixture, execution contract or acceptance event has been instantiated.
Source-defined unresolved states, missing evidence, inapplicability, refusal, effects and falsification remain distinct; no live case has been classified or resolved.

conditions: An exact authorized work instruction activates a bound frame for an actor and subject.

grounding.quote:
The Product definition records the
durable shared basis. A ticket or other authorized work instruction carries the
activation packet. That execution binding does not mutate the Product Definition
Overlay. The overlay does not register agents, assign permanent frames, or
persist temporary active frame configurations.

relations.meaning: An activation is scoped under an applicable collective declaration and exact grant, distinct from and non-mutating of the durable Product basis.

grounding.quote:
The **Tenant Registry** is the canonical `how.build_tenants` collection for the
product's independent `HOW` realizations. Each entry has stable identity and
